profile.Name: Black Dog
profile.Job: Leader of the Black Dog mercenaries
profile.Personality: Pushy, arrogant, and quick to take offense. He boasts of being one of the best mercenaries in the land and treats any refusal of his protection as an insult.
profile.Backstory: He leads the Black Dog mercenaries from Black Dog HQ. He warns travelers of the dangers ahead, such as skull collectors, gorillos, gutters, and blood bandits, then sells his protection for 2500 cats a day. Anyone who refuses or wastes his time is told to pay compensation or face his mercs.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Calls people 'outlander', 'fool', or 'worm'. Threatens that 'The Black Dog mercs rule these outlands!' and promises to etch the name into a foe's flesh.
